title: Step 6: A Command Line
story: Give your shortener a tiny interface.
goal: Loop over stdin: `short <url>` prints the code, `go <code>` prints the link or `not found`, bad links print `ERR ...`.

tests.label: Counts hits
tests.expr: [list(x) for x in (lambda s: [s.shorten('http://a.com'), s.shorten('http://b.com'), s.expand('1'), s.expand('1'), s.expand('2'), s.top(2)][5])(Shortener())]

tests.label: Works from stdin
tests.expect:
1
http://a.com
not found
ERR only http and https links

hints: Split each line into a command and the rest.
Catch ValueError and print ERR plus its message.
socratic: What should this new piece take in, and give back?
Which earlier piece can you reuse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
